name: Dugeundugeun Yeonseubsaeng Yeon-Aeilji
source:
21st century, South Korea is under cultural dictatorial regime of idol stars.

A handful of new idol groups make their debut every week, and all the broadcasting studios in the country are busy producing their own idol star audition programs. Me' that happened to get involved with my dad's scheme(?), becomes part of his management company's group of trainees under a man's disguise...

And my encounter with the six charming trainees of the company! What's coming between, amateur and talentless, 'me' and the six eye candies?
translation:
21世纪的韩国，正处于偶像明星的文化独裁之下。

每周都有好几个新偶像组合出道，全国各大电视台都忙着制作自己的偶像选秀节目。不知怎么卷入老爸的盘算（？）的“我”，女扮男装，成为了他旗下经纪公司的练习生之一……

就这样，我遇见了公司里六位魅力十足的练习生！既是外行又没什么天赋的“我”，与这六位养眼的帅哥之间，究竟会发生什么？
